## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `057ce4365b6bec13a932962c05c744dbe04ac6eb`
Local-runs: none

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept set: none — the diff is published skill text and one eval file; no package code, no contract. The surface is the published catalog (`npx skills add objectstack-ai/objectstack/skills`), and the text now says what `main`'s door does: `FLOW_NODE_TEXT_SLOTS` is exactly five positions (notify `title` / `message`, screen `title` / `description`, end `message`), judged by `flow-text-slot-template.ts` at `registerFlow` and `objectstack validate`.
- The notify example (SKILL.md 108–109): `title: 'Done: {{ record.title }}'` and `message: 'Closed {{ record.closed_at | date:long }}'`. Measured by the dev on the built dists: both accepted by `NotifyConfigSchema`, compiled by `validateExpression('template', …)`, rendered by the template engine; the old lines refused with the door's own remedies (`Done: {record.title}` → `Done: {{ record.title }}`; `{$User.Id}` "is not a variable, so no hole spells it: compute it into a variable with an `assignment` node"). Right: the `message` example could not be flipped mechanically — the old token has no hole spelling — so it became a path-plus-formatter a reader can copy.
- The dialect paragraph (old 236–241): three statements, one door each — text slots render `{{ }}` holes (a path, an optional formatter, no logic) and `os validate` / `registerFlow` refuse a `{…}` token there with its `{{ }}` spelling; `{$User.Id}` / `{NOW()}` have no hole and `{{ $User.Id }}` renders blank, so assign a variable first; every other slot (`recipients`, `inputs`, `http`, `filter`) keeps the single-brace template. The false "`{{x}}` is the template-field dialect" clause is gone. Right against `main`: the five text slots are the whole set, and the value-slot half (#22259, landed) already matches item 1 of the same list.
- Eval id 2: `expected_output` names `title: 'Won: {{ record.name }}'`; `must_contain` gains `{{`; `must_not_contain` drops `{{` (a pin of the old dialect that would have failed the right answer) and keeps `trigger:`; no single-brace pin added, since `recipients` keeps the single brace. Right.
- Beyond the three named sites, inside the claimed file: the § Filter tokens bullets (old 207–208 and 213–214) no longer list `title` / `message` as single-brace positions ("in `url` a bare `{current_year_start}` is a nonsense reference"; "outside a filter (a `{{ }}` hole, `http` url)"), and the section's two-line lede was deleted to pay the token ratchet — its substance survives at lines 161–162 ("a dropped filter condition **widens** the query") and in the second bullet (the condition is DROPPED and the node refuses to execute). Right.
- Budget: SKILL.md 439 → 438 lines, 23,052 → 23,129 bytes; the eval 55 → 55 lines; the published catalog has a TOKEN ratchet, not a line ratchet (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, shrink-only) — on the head SKILL.md 5,783 / 5,785 and the eval 1,253 / 1,255, exit 0, no ceiling moved. No re-wrap. Operative text carries no issue number.
- Pin: a `title` / `message` / `description` value holding a `{` with no `{` on either side (the lookaround form; the dispatch's `\{[^{]` also matched the second brace of a hole) — base: SKILL.md 108 and 109; head: 0 hits across all of `skills/`. Right.
- Public surface: the published skill only; `Clause-②: no` is correct.

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: no` on the claim and the PR body; `skip-changeset` is the correct declaration — `skills/**` is in no published package's `files[]`. No `.changeset/*.md` touched.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Mechanism assumptions corrected by measurement: #3 is half-true (the value-slot C half of #19939 landed in #22259 — `fields.*` / assignment values refuse `{…}` with the CEL spelling, date macros and `{$User.*}` kept; the skill's item 1 already said so); #7 — no line ratchet covers `skills/**` by design, the token ratchet does, and 88 bytes of SKILL.md headroom bounded the rewrite. Both recorded on the PR.
- "The same reference outside a filter (a `{{ }}` hole, `http` url) only renders an empty string — a warning": the sentence is inherited from the single-brace era and kept for holes; the blank render was measured for `{{ $User.Id }}` (`ok: true`), the unknown-field warning at validate for a hole was read, not measured — for the maintainer's eye, not blocking.
- The skill eval run is NOT MEASURED: no runner in this repository reads `must_contain` / `must_not_contain` (the tree holds only the eval JSONs and two READMEs); the assertions are judged by reading, and `{{` is a substring the right answer contains.
- CI on the head at this write: `Test Core (1/6)`, `Test Core (2/6)`, `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Type Check · workspace` still `in_progress`, nothing red; the dev's 24-family union ran exit 0 on the head (`--ran` 24/24).
- Git identity: one commit, authored and committed by `objectstack-fleet[bot]` with the fleet e-mail, model-free trailer pair — no deviation.
- `open_questions`: none. Out-of-scope findings: `{{ $User.Id }}` in a text slot passes `objectstack validate` and renders blank with `ok: true` (measured: the schema accepts, the engine evaluates to `By `) — a silent-drop trap the new paragraph warns about; the door should refuse a `$`-root no flow variable can resolve the way it refuses `{$User.Id}` — the seat files it for the spec lane (link on the card); SKILL.md:154 (`{NODE_ID.error}` / `{$error}`) names no slot — noted; the eval's token ceiling is lowerable to 1,253 — polish, outside this surface.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-22454-automation-skill-text-slot-delimiter`
Reviewed-by: `session_01JmWtcHfGbC4ncw4GFKWuRA`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读 — PR #22475(#22454)— skills 席 1,2026-10-09T12:02Z

- **改了什么:** 已发布技能 `objectstack-automation` 的两个文件。`SKILL.md`:notify 示例改成 `title: 'Done: {{ record.title }}'` / `message: 'Closed {{ record.closed_at | date:long }}'`;"文本槽"那段改成三句、各对一道门(notify/screen/end 的五个文本槽读 `{{ }}` hole,`validate` / `registerFlow` 拒单括号并给出 `{{ }}` 拼写;`{$User.Id}` / `{NOW()}` 没有 hole、`{{ $User.Id }}` 渲染空白,先赋变量;`recipients` / `inputs` / `http` / `filter` 仍是单括号),删掉"`{{x}}` 是 template-field 方言"的假句;§ Filter tokens 两处把 `title` / `message` 从单括号位置里拿掉,删两行导语付 token 棘轮(实质在 161–162 行与同节第二条)。eval 2 的期望改为 `title: 'Won: {{ record.name }}'`,`{{` 从 `must_not_contain` 挪到 `must_contain`。净 −1 行、+77 字节,token 棘轮 5,783/5,785 与 1,253/1,255。
- **为什么改:** PR #22315 落地后 `main` 在构建门与保存门拒绝文本槽里的单括号 token;这份技能经 `npx skills add` 装进客户项目,AI 作者先读它、再被门拒。旧示例两行在构建产物上实测被拒(门自己给出 `{{ }}` 拼写),新示例实测被接受并渲染。
- **风险与代价(含回滚):** 纯文本,不碰代码、不发包、无 changeset;值槽指引一字未扩(#22259 已落的那半与技能原句一致)。回滚 = 还原两个文件的一次提交。一处边界给你过目:`{{ $User.Id }}` 写在文本槽里能过 `validate`、渲染成空白(`ok: true`)——技能新段已警告,本席另立 finding 给 spec 车道让门响亮拒绝。
- **席位意见:** 建议批准。三处改法逐一对应 `main` 上 `FLOW_NODE_TEXT_SLOTS` 的五个位置与门的拒绝句,不新增任何声明;删导语有家、棘轮只减不增。席内契约复核 PASS 在案(6080468777)。
- **你要做的:** 看一眼 82 行 diff,认可就给一个 APPROVED;批准后席位落地(你顺手 ready + auto-merge 也可)。
